author: curriculum-architect
songSummary: Practices the keyboard from low G to high G, run-ning and long notes, A-B-A-B song form, a big leap, counting in threes and two-hand teamwork.

classes.title: From low G to high G
classes.goal: Find the low G and high G that frame the song, and learn the first half.

mathTarget.parentLine: The whole song lives between two Gs, low and high

classes.parentPrompt: Point to low G, then high G, eight white keys apart; the song lives in between.
classes.childAction: Find low G and high G. Then play the first line.
classes.bridge: Low G and high G are the two fences of the open range.

intro.caption: Find the two fences: G and G
intro.parentCue: point low G, then high G, together

games.caption: Low G, high G: same name
games.parentCue: Point left, then right, with each sound

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: the song's space from low G to high G.

classes.title: Run-ning up to the sky
classes.goal: Learn the second line: two quick notes run up to a long G.

mathTarget.parentLine: The long G lasts as long as four quick notes

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'run-ning' on the quick notes, then 'sky' and hold it while counting 1, 2.
classes.childAction: Run-ning up E, F, then hold the big sky G.
classes.bridge: Quick notes are the deer running; the long G is the wide sky.

intro.caption: Run-ning... up to the sky!
intro.parentCue: say it slowly, then hold the long note

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: quick notes and a long note.

classes.title: Spot the twin lines
classes.goal: Play the whole song slowly and find which lines share the same music.

mathTarget.parentLine: Two lines are twins; the other two are almost twins

classes.parentPrompt: Say 'A' for the buffalo music and 'B' for the sky music as each line starts.
classes.childAction: Play slowly and say 'A!' or 'B!' as each line starts.
classes.bridge: The buffalo line comes twice with new words; the music is the same.

intro.caption: Which lines are twins?
intro.parentCue: say A or B as each line starts

games.caption: Tap the beat: the first line
games.parentCue: Play the blue keys; your child taps the beat

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: hearing which lines repeat, A and B.

classes.title: The buffalo's big leap
classes.goal: Practise the big jump from A up to F slowly, then a little faster.

mathTarget.parentLine: Counting the keys between two notes tells how far to jump

classes.parentPrompt: Count the white keys from A to F with your child: A, B, C, D, E, F.
classes.childAction: Count the keys from A to F, then jump the buffalo there.
classes.bridge: Most notes walk next door; this one leaps far to the right, like a buffalo.

intro.caption: How far does the buffalo jump?
intro.parentCue: count the white keys from A to F

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: measuring and making a big leap.

classes.title: One-two-three, low on one
classes.goal: Play one low left-hand note at the start of each bar of three.

mathTarget.parentLine: This song counts in threes: One, two, three

classes.parentPrompt: Play the tune and count 'one, two, three' out loud, loudest on one.
classes.childAction: Left hand plays one low note on every one. Then wait two.
classes.bridge: Low notes live on the left, like the ground under the buffalo's hooves.

intro.caption: One, two, three, one, two, three

games.caption: Find the low notes
games.parentCue: Point to each low key first

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: counting in threes, landing on one.

classes.title: Ground below, sky above
classes.goal: Play the tune with one low note per bar: one hand holds while the other moves.

mathTarget.parentLine: One low note lasts while three beats pass above

classes.parentPrompt: Rest a hand on your child's left shoulder and say 'ground' on each low note. Go slowly.
classes.childAction: Left hand holds the low ground; right hand plays the tune.
classes.bridge: Left hand is the ground, still and low; right hand is the sky moving.

intro.caption: Two hands, two jobs
intro.parentCue: both hands on the keys, very slowly

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: two hands doing two different jobs.

classes.title: Strong, light, light
classes.goal: Play both hands a little faster, with a strong one and two light beats.

mathTarget.parentLine: One strong beat, then two light ones, again and again

classes.parentPrompt: Sway beside your child: a big sway on one, small sways on two, three.
classes.childAction: Play a strong one and two light beats. Too fast? Slow down.
classes.bridge: One is a big buffalo step; two and three are light deer steps.

intro.caption: Strong, light, light
intro.parentCue: big sway on one, small on two, three

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a strong beat and two light beats.

classes.title: Ride the open range
classes.goal: Play the whole song along with the music at full speed and keep going.

mathTarget.parentLine: Fitting your playing to a speed you did not choose

classes.parentPrompt: Sing the words beside your child; if notes are missed, keep going and smile.
classes.childAction: Play along with the music. Missed notes? Keep riding!
classes.bridge: Cowboys and settlers carried this song west across the wide open land.

intro.caption: Ride along with the music
intro.parentCue: sing the words softly beside your child

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: keeping up with the music.

classes.title: Home under big skies
classes.goal: Play the whole song for teddy and hear the open ending, then the home ending.

mathTarget.parentLine: Line two stops on D, open; the last lands home on C

classes.parentPrompt: Sit teddy as the audience; hold the last C long, then bow together.
classes.childAction: Play to the end, land home on C, and take a bow.
classes.bridge: D is a cabin door left open; C closes it, home at last.

intro.caption: A song for teddy!
intro.parentCue: put teddy in front as the audience

classes.celebrate: Today you practiced: a whole song, an open and a home ending.
